title: Support Pieces In The Generalized Lattice Model
body_html:
Support Pieces In The Generalized Lattice Model

For $(x,x')\in B(G)\times B(G')$, the theta draft writes

$$ \omega_{x,x'} $$

for the generalized lattice model of the Weil representation attached to the tensor lattice function $\mathcal B_{x,x'}$.

It also chooses an isomorphism

$$ \mathfrak W_{x,x'}:\omega_{x,x'}\overset{\sim}{\longrightarrow}\omega $$

to the abstract Weil representation, and then identifies subspaces of $\omega_{x,x'}$ with their images in $\omega$.

For $w\in W$, the support piece is

$$ \omega_{x,x',w} := \{f\in\omega_{x,x'}:\operatorname{supp}(f)\subseteq w+\mathcal B_{x,x',0}\}. $$

Draft Caution

The current TeX calls $\mathfrak W_{x,x'}$ a fixed equivariant isomorphism. Transition maps between different choices are not made canonical there; this is exactly the issue isolated in the lattice-model transition problem.
